name: BITEZ XL - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP 4000MG Gummies - Passion Fruit Pineapple
description:
*DOUBLE THE STRENGTH OF OUR REGULAR BITEZ GUMMIES!

Close your eyes and you're there. Passion Fruit Pineapple BITEZ XL Gummies deliver a double-stacked explosion of sun-ripened pineapple and tangy, floral passion fruit that hits your taste buds like a tropical vacation in every single bite. Sweet, bold, and impossibly refreshing. Double the strength, double the flavor—each XL gummy packs a powerful 2,000mg Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend (2 gummies per bag, 4,000mg total).
